name: South Harz Potash Limited
summary: South Harz Potash Limited explores for and develops mineral properties in Germany, mainly potash. It fully owns the South Harz projects, which include three mining licences at Ohmgebirge, Mühlhausen-Nohra and Ebeleben and two exploration licences at Küllstedt and Gräfentonna. Established in 2011, it was formerly Davenport Resources Limited.
